I am a Quantitative Finance student with interests in quantitative risk, financial modelling, derivatives, time series, and statistical methods in finance.

This site serves as a place to document research projects, implementations, and shorter notes on topics I explore independently.

## Areas of Interest

- Quantitative Risk Management
- Derivatives and Pricing
- Market and Portfolio Risk
- Time Series and Volatility Modelling
- Statistical Methods in Finance
- Computational Finance

## Tools

I primarily work with Python and use this site alongside GitHub to document code and research.
